Jenkins 3-Tier DevSecOps Architecture

This repository is the CI/CD control repo, not the application. It holds the Jenkinsfile pipeline, an AWS setup guide, an architecture document, a one-off patch script and screenshots. The 3-tier app lives in a separate GitHub repo that the pipeline references.

Pipeline12-stage Jenkins declarative pipeline (Fail-fast)
TiersWeb · App · Database (separate GitHub repo)
ScanningOWASP Dependency-Check · Trivy · SonarQube
ArchivalReports + Slack on success/fail

1 Architecture

A push to GitHub triggers Jenkins on EC2-1, which orchestrates scanning, building, pushing and deploying. SonarQube calls back to Jenkins with a quality-gate webhook, and the verified image runs on a target EC2 as three tiers.

End-to-end flow

Developergit push
GitHubsource of truth · webhook / SCM polling
Jenkins master (EC2-1, :8080)orchestrates stages · enforces gates · Slack
Security gatesSonarQube :9000 · OWASP Dependency-Check · Trivy
Registry (ECR / Docker Hub)immutable :git-sha tag
Target EC2Docker + docker-compose
Web :80/443 · App internal · DB no public inbound3 tiers
source / triggercompute / orchestrationsecurity gatesregistryrunning app

SonarQube calls back to Jenkins through the quality-gate webhook, so the pipeline can block on waitForQualityGate(). Trivy hard-fails the build on HIGH or CRITICAL findings.

Sizing: at least 4 GB RAM and 12 GB storage. SonarQube's Lucene indexer needs vm.max_map_count=262144.

2. Components

ComponentRole
GitHubSource of truth; triggers Jenkins via webhook/SCM polling
Jenkins (EC2-1)Orchestrator: runs stages, enforces gates, archives reports, notifies Slack
SonarQube (Docker, :9000)SAST + code quality/coverage; owns the Quality Gate webhook
OWASP Dependency-CheckSCA: known CVEs in declared dependencies (NVD)
TrivyContainer image scan (OS + library CVEs) and filesystem/IaC scan (misconfigurations, secrets)
Docker + BuildKitImage build with --secret so credentials never land in image layers
Registry (ECR/Docker Hub)Stores the verified image with an immutable :git-sha tag
Target EC2Runs docker-compose for the 3 tiers (web/app/db)
AWS security groups22 SSH, 8080 Jenkins, 9000 SonarQube, 80/443 app

3. Pipeline workflow (Jenkinsfile)

Twelve declarative stages run in fail-fast order. Red nodes in the animation are hard gates.

#StageWhat happensGate
1CheckoutClone main, capture short GIT_COMMIT—
2Compile & Testnpm ci / mvn clean test / pip installTest failure stops build
3Build Docker imageBuildKit --secret id=azkey, tags :latest + :GIT_COMMIT—
4SonarQube Analysis (SAST)sonar-scanner, sonar.projectKey=jenkins-3tier—
5OWASP Dependency-Check (SCA)dependency-check --scan . --format ALL, reports archived—
6Trivy: container scantrivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 + SARIFHard fail on HIGH/CRITICAL
7Trivy: filesystem/IaC scantrivy fs, HTML report archived—
8Sonar Quality GatewaitForQualityGate(); non-OK raises errorBlocks pipeline
9Push to registrydocker login + push :GIT_COMMITOnly reached if 1–8 pass
10Deploy via SSHssh ubuntu@EC2_HOST → docker-compose pull && up -d—
11Smoke testPoll http://EC2_HOST/health up to 12×5 sRollback signal
12PostAlways archive reports + cleanWs(); Slack on success/failure/unstable—

Flow with gates

Stages 1–3checkout · test · build image
Stages 4–7SAST · SCA · Trivy image · Trivy fs
Hard stopsTrivy HIGH/CRITICAL exit-code 1 · Sonar Quality Gate
Stage 9: push :git-shaonly if everything before passed
Stages 10–11: deploy + smoke testSSH compose up · /health polled 12×5 s
Stage 12: postarchive reports · cleanWs · Slack

4. Key security properties

Pipeline guarantees

  • Scan before push: no unscanned image ever reaches the registry.
  • Gate before deploy: the SonarQube Quality Gate and Trivy severity threshold are hard stops.
  • No baked secrets: BuildKit --secret, never COPY of .env.

Audit trail (archived per build)

  • dependency-check-report.*
  • trivy-*.html / .sarif
  • sonar-report.json
